items.title_zh: Claude 没能造出蝎子抗毒血清
items.title_en: Claude did not invent scorpion antivenom
items.summary_zh: 投资研究机构 Citrini Research 想证明 AI 能颠覆药物研发，于是与 Anthropic 合作，测试一个尚未发布的 Claude 版本能否从零设计出蝎子抗毒血清。结果是失败的：据 The Verge 采访的专家说法，Claude 给出了一些有希望的起点，但距离真正的药物相去甚远。Citrini Research 自己也承认，“我们中没有一个人敢说了解 AI 与生物学的关系”。尽管如此，该机构仍尝试用 AI 从零造药，并发布了题为“我们想用 Claude 创造一种新药……”的博客文章。
items.summary_en: An investment research firm wanted to prove AI could revolutionize drug development. So they teamed up with Anthropic to see whether an unreleased version of Claude could make scorpion antivenom. It couldn't. It came up with some promising starting points, but nothing close to an actual drug, experts tell The Verge . Citrini Research, the firm behind the experiment, admitted that "none of us could claim to know anything about AI as it related to biology." That didn't stop it from trying to make a drug from scratch - or publishing a blog post titled "We Wanted to Use Claude to Create a New Drug…
items.why_zh: 这是对“AI 能否端到端颠覆药物研发”这一流行叙事的一次公开现实检验。
items.why_en: It is a public reality check on the popular narrative that AI can reinvent drug discovery end to end.

items.title_zh: 商务部：截至 2025 年末，我国每个家庭平均拥有手机 2.5 部
items.title_en: China's Commerce Ministry: Households Owned 2.5 Mobile Phones on Average by End-2025
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 22 日消息，国新办今日举行“开局起步‘十五五’”系列主题新闻发布会，介绍推进“十五五”时期商务高质量发展有关情况。 会上介绍，我国居民消费正在由追求“量的满足”向“质的提升”转变。截至 2025 年末， 我国每个家庭平均拥有手机 2.5 部 、电视 1.1 台、冰箱 1.1 台、洗衣机 1 台。在“有没有”的问题已经解决后，大家自然更加关注“好不好”。 一方面，消费者更加注重商品和服务的质量，“既要花得值、更要买得对”；另一方面，不同消费群体需求呈现多样化、个性化、差异化特点。绿色、智能、健康等消费需求不断释放。例如，从智能手机到智能穿戴，再到当前火爆的人形机器人和外骨骼机器人，各类智能产品正在逐步走进千家万户。 图源：Pexels IT之家查询获悉，2026 年 1-9 月，国内市场手机出货量 1.89 亿部，其中，5G 手机 1.71 亿部，占同期手机出货量的 90.6%。 2026 年 9 月，国内手机上市新机型 45 款，其中 5G 手机 33 款，同比增长 43.5%，占同期手机上市新机型数量的 73.3%。2026 年 1-9 月，国内手机上市新机型 286 款，同比下降 28.1%，其中 5G 手机 174 款，同比下降 3.3%，占同期手机上市新机型数量的 60.8%。
items.summary_en: At a State Council Information Office briefing on October 22, China's Commerce Ministry said household consumption is shifting from quantity to quality, citing average household ownership by end-2025 of 2.5 mobile phones, 1.1 TVs, 1.1 refrigerators and one washing machine. Officials said green, smart and health-related demand is growing, with humanoid and exoskeleton robots entering homes. Domestic phone shipments reached 189 million units in January-September 2026, 90.6% of them 5G.
items.why_zh: 这组数据勾勒出中国消费电子市场从普及转向升级的结构性变化，是观察智能硬件需求的重要依据。
items.why_en: The figures map China's shift from device saturation to upgrade demand, a key signal for smart-hardware vendors.

items.title_zh: 任天堂 Switch 2 软件破解方案 ns2jb 发布，可修改《马力欧卡丁车 世界》
items.title_en: Switch 2 Software Jailbreak 'ns2jb' Released, Works on Latest Firmware
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 22 日消息，开发者 pepsipu 今日介绍了一项名为 ns2jb 的任天堂 Switch 2 软件破解方案，称其可在 NS2 最新的 23.0.1 系统固件上运行，且无需硬件改造。 据介绍，该方案能够在系统服务进程中执行原生代码，为运行自制程序、修改游戏及备份存档等功能提供了技术基础。 pepsipu 表示，ns2jb 并非永久性越狱，重启后便需要重新触发。其技术实现涉及 Switch 2 对初代 Switch 游戏的兼容机制，研究人员利用 SmileBASIC 解释器中的 32 位整数溢出漏洞，进一步获得内存读写能力，并突破系统文件服务进程的部分安全限制。 具体而言，该漏洞出现在 SmileBASIC 解释器的数组删除操作中。由于程序未能正确处理 32 位整数溢出，研究人员得以越界读写内存，并以此为基础推进后续漏洞利用。pepsipu 随后通过系统文件服务进程 fs 等组件，进一步实现了在系统服务进程中执行原生代码的能力。 在公布的视频演示中，他修改了 Switch 2 独占游戏《马力欧卡丁车 世界》，成功将三丽鸥角色大耳狗、愤怒的小鸟中的胖红等非原版角色加入游戏。 开发者还透露，这项研究使用了 OpenAI Codex 辅助漏洞分析和利用开发，但整个破解过程耗时约两周；《马力欧卡丁车 世界》的角色修改则在一天内完成。为了自动化测试，研究人员搭建了包含初代…
items.summary_en: Developer pepsipu released ns2jb, a software-only jailbreak for the Nintendo Switch 2 that reportedly works on the latest 23.0.1 firmware without hardware modification. It exploits a 32-bit integer overflow in the SmileBASIC interpreter reached via Switch 2's backward compatibility with original Switch games, then uses the fs service to run native code in a system service process. It is not permanent and must be re-triggered after reboot; the demo modified Mario Kart World to add non-native characters.
items.why_zh: 这是 Switch 2 上市后较早公开的软件级破解，可能影响任天堂的安全策略与盗版治理。
items.why_en: It is one of the first publicly demonstrated software-only hacks of the Switch 2, with implications for Nintendo's security and anti-piracy strategy.

items.title_zh: 蚂蚁数科发布决策模型 LingDT-Decision-1.0，将 Token 消耗降低超 90%
items.title_en: Ant Digital launches LingDT-Decision-1.0, cutting token use by over 90%
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 22 日消息，蚂蚁数科今日发布决策模型 LingDT-Decision-1.0。该模型专为快速产业决策打造，在处理结构化决策任务时，具备准确率更高、响应更快、Token 成本更低等优势。 据介绍，相比于其他决策模型，LingDT-Decision-1.0 首创 支持原生多选与按序决策能力 ，更适配企业真实应用场景。在 23 项开源评测基准中，LingDT-Decision-1.0 的性能超过了 Microsoft-Decision-1、Jev 1.13.等热门决策模型，LingDT-Decision-1.0 的 27B 版本在同参数模型中取得 最高准确率 。 蚂蚁数科团队在客服、风控、金融等真实业务场景测试显示，在处理同样任务时，LingDT-Decision-1.0 相比于大语言模型， 可将 Token 消耗降低超 90% ，响应时效提升 10 倍，并且性能表现更优。 在企业实际应用中，存在大量高频的决策类任务。例如，在客服场景中，当收到“这个订单已经三天了还没发货，请尽快处理。”的问询后，AI 需要快速进行一系列判断和决策：问题类型（退款、催单还是投诉？）、工单紧急度（是否需要优先处理）、归属部门（工单派到哪个部门）以及风险判断（是否需要人工接管）。 传统大语言模型在这类场景中存在明显短板。大语言模型通常需要逐字（Token）进行推理，再生成输出文本，链路长…
items.summary_en: Ant Digital released LingDT-Decision-1.0, a decision model for fast industrial use cases, claiming higher accuracy, faster responses, and lower token costs on structured decision tasks. It supports native multi-select and ordered decisions, outperforms models such as Microsoft-Decision-1 and Jev 1.13 on 23 open benchmarks, and its 27B version ranks highest among same-size models. In customer service, risk, and finance tests, it cut token use by over 90% and improved response speed 10x versus LLMs.
items.why_zh: 企业高频决策任务需要短链路、低成本推理，专用决策模型可能比通用大模型更适合落地。
items.why_en: High-frequency enterprise decisions need short-chain, low-cost inference, making specialized decision models potentially better suited than general LLMs.

items.summary_en: On Tesla’s earnings call, Musk said the company is seeking broader FSD regulatory approval in China and cooperating with Chinese regulators, while acknowledging that local automakers are highly competitive and Tesla has not yet built a true lead there. Tesla reported 1.74 million active paid FSD users globally, up 67% year over year, with subscriptions reaching 50% of the mix for the first time. Excluding regulatory credits, automotive gross margin rose to 18.1% from 16.3%, partly helped by FSD software revenue.

It uses a 3rd-gen Intel Core 7 350 processor built on the Wildcat Lake architecture and Intel 18A process, with six cores, up to 4.8GHz, 6MB L3 cache, Intel Graphics 2Xe Cores with XeSS support, and a 17 TOPS NPU 5. The review focuses on performance testing and its suitability for business and AI workloads.

items.title_zh: 米哈游联合清华北大等高校发布开源 GameScaling 游戏模型，覆盖 0.8B 至 27B 参数规模
items.title_en: miHoYo and universities open-source GameScaling game models from 0.8B to 27B
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 22 日消息，有用户发现，米哈游崩坏 AI 研发团队、清华大学、北京大学、中国科学院大学、香港大学、新加坡国立大学等机构联合推出了 GameScaling 系列游戏模型并已经开源。 研究团队围绕游戏场景中的模型规模扩展规律（Scaling Law）展开研究，并发布了覆盖 0.8B 至 27B 参数规模的 8 个模型检查点。 该项目团队在 GitHub 页面描述称， 该系列模型基于 Qwen3.5 视觉语言模型继续预训练 ，训练数据涉及键盘和鼠标操作的游戏过程。IT之家从官方获悉，该模型能够接收当前游戏画面及此前的部分画面、操作记录，并生成后续的键盘和鼠标操作指令，以控制游戏角色行动。 在游戏场景方面，GameScaling 支持《我的世界》《毁灭战士》等不同类型的游戏任务，包括在《我的世界》中采矿、合成物品和对抗僵尸，在《毁灭战士》中战斗与寻路，以及在密室场景中完成解谜和逃脱任务。 根据项目提供的技术说明，模型每次调用会生成覆盖约 200 毫秒的操作序列，其中包含 6 个、每个持续 33 毫秒的操作步骤，以及鼠标移动和滚轮指令。项目介绍还提到，该系列模型面向实时游戏交互设计，具体运行速度会受到模型规模、硬件配置和推理负载等因素影响。 该系列共开源 8 个模型版本，分别为 0.8B、2B、9B 和 27B 四种参数规模，每种规模各有 S1、S3 两个版本。其中，S…
items.summary_en: miHoYo’s Honkai AI team, together with Tsinghua, Peking University, UCAS, HKU, NUS, and other institutions, has open-sourced the GameScaling series to study scaling laws in game scenarios. Based on Qwen3.5 vision-language models and trained on keyboard-and-mouse gameplay, the models take current and past frames plus action history and output future control commands. The release covers 0.8B, 2B, 9B, and 27B sizes with S1/S3 variants, supporting tasks in Minecraft, Doom, and escape-room puzzles with roughly 200ms action sequences per call.
items.why_zh: 游戏是检验视觉语言模型实时决策与操作能力的复杂场景，开源系列有助于研究游戏智能的扩展规律。
items.why_en: Games are a demanding testbed for real-time vision-language decision-making, and the open series can help study scaling laws for game agents.

items.title_en: Unitree's Wang Xingxing Unveils Three Strategic Directions and a Multi-Million-Yuan Physical AI Competition
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 22 日消息，据证券时报报道，2026 世界物理 AI 大会暨宇树合作伙伴生态大会今日在浙江杭州举行，宇树科技董事长、总经理兼首席技术官王兴兴在大会上明确 宇树科技三大未来布局方向 ： 一是提升机器人大规模量产能力，适配未来千万级乃至亿级的市场需求； 二是自研与合作并行，推进适配自身硬件的物理 AI 小模型落地； 三是布局超大规模算力集群，筑牢技术迭代底座。 同时，宇树科技正在搭建机器人自进化体系，通过“AI 自主研发 — 仿真训练 — 真实测试 — 反馈迭代”的闭环模式，替代传统人工调试路径，提升算法迭代效率。 王兴兴在会上官宣世界物理 AI 大赛。 该赛事每年投入数千万元人民币奖金，面向全球团队与个人开放 ，设置任意移动、田径、格斗、灵巧操作、生产、体育赛事、多模态交互、康养八大赛道，旨在凝聚全球创新力量，推动物理 AI 技术边界持续突破。
items.summary_en: At the 2026 World Physical AI Conference in Hangzhou, Unitree's Wang Xingxing outlined three priorities: mass production for millions-to-billions of robots, physical AI small models tailored to its hardware, and ultra-large compute clusters. Unitree is also building a self-evolution loop from AI R&D and simulation to real-world testing and feedback. Wang announced a global Physical AI Competition with tens of millions of yuan in annual prizes across eight tracks.
items.why_zh: 这显示宇树正从机器人本体量产转向“硬件+物理 AI 模型+算力”的系统性竞争。
items.why_en: It shows Unitree is moving from robot hardware mass production toward systemic competition spanning hardware, physical AI models and compute.

items.title_zh: AI 被忽视的存储账单：推理之后数据留在了哪里
items.title_en: AI’s hidden storage bill: What inference leaves behind
items.summary_zh: 文章指出，企业高管谈到 AI 成本时往往只想到 GPU、加速器集群和电力，却忽略了数据存储。模型完成推理后，每天数十亿次提示、图像和视频所产生的后端数据仍需被保存，而存储是 AI 基础设施中最难规划的成本之一，常在初期规划中被遗漏。随着推理规模扩大，数据足迹同步增长，存储支出会持续累积。
items.summary_en: Ask most executives to picture the cost of AI and they’ll likely see GPUs—racks of accelerators with gigawatts of power—and a waitlist for silicon. But that picture leaves something out: Data storage costs. What happens to data after a model responds? Much of the back-end data that’s generated—from billions of daily prompts, images, and videos—needs to be stored. But data storage is one of the harder infrastructure costs to plan for, and it’s often overlooked in initial AI infrastructure planning. As inference scales, the data footprint grows with it Traditionally, AI infrastructure conversati…
items.why_zh: 推理规模化会让存储成为 AI 成本结构中容易被低估却持续上升的一项。
items.why_en: As inference scales, storage becomes an easily underestimated but steadily rising part of AI costs.

items.summary_zh: 稀缺不是护城河，智谱跌去万亿市值的深刻启示 21财经
items.summary_en: A 21st Century Business Herald commentary argues that scarcity is not a moat, citing Zhipu's sharp market value decline as a cautionary tale. The headline refers to a trillion-yuan loss in value, though the excerpt does not provide detailed financial figures. The piece is a commentary on how AI companies should build durable competitive advantages.
items.why_zh: 它提醒 AI 公司的估值不能只建立在稀缺叙事上，而需要真实壁垒和商业化能力。
items.why_en: It warns that AI valuations cannot rest on scarcity narratives alone and require real moats and commercialization.

items.title_zh: DeepSeek更新模型 官方点名WorkBuddy
items.title_en: DeepSeek Updates Model, Officially Mentions WorkBuddy
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek更新模型 官方点名WorkBuddy 凤凰网财经
items.summary_en: Phoenix Finance reports that DeepSeek has updated its model and officially mentioned WorkBuddy. The report did not disclose the version number, specific capability improvements or how WorkBuddy relates to DeepSeek's model. More details are awaited.
items.why_zh: 头部模型公司的一次更新及外部产品点名，可能透露其生态合作或应用落地方向。
items.why_en: An update from a leading model company and its mention of an external product may hint at ecosystem partnerships or application directions.

items.title_zh: 17岁Kimi前研究员 被爆或加盟估值500亿美元创业公司
items.title_en: 17-Year-Old Former Kimi Researcher Reportedly May Join $50B Startup
items.summary_zh: 17岁Kimi前研究员 被爆或加盟估值500亿美元创业公司 搜狐
items.summary_en: Sohu reports that a 17-year-old former Kimi researcher may join a startup valued at about $50 billion. The report did not name the researcher, the startup or the role. The move remains unconfirmed.
items.why_zh: 年轻 AI 人才流向高估值创业公司，反映顶尖研究人才争夺仍在升温。
items.why_en: The flow of young AI talent to high-valuation startups shows the competition for top researchers remains intense.

items.title_zh: DeepSeek据悉新一轮融资约1000亿元，投前估值约5000亿元
items.title_en: DeepSeek Reportedly Raising About 100 Billion Yuan at 500 Billion Yuan Pre-Money Valuation
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek据悉新一轮融资约1000亿元，投前估值约5000亿元 虎嗅
items.summary_en: Chinese media reports say AI model developer DeepSeek is raising roughly 10 billion yuan (about $15 billion) at a pre-money valuation of around 50 billion yuan, with Tencent and CATL among the reported participants. The company has not confirmed the deal. If accurate, it would rank among the largest single funding rounds for a Chinese AI model startup.
items.why_zh: 若消息属实，这将是国内大模型行业规模最大的融资之一，显示资本正加速向头部模型公司集中。
items.why_en: If confirmed, it would be one of the largest funding rounds in China's LLM sector, signaling that capital is concentrating around leading model developers.

items.title_zh: 腾讯宁德时代联手，DeepSeek 这 150 亿美元融资意在挑战谁
items.title_en: Tencent and CATL Join DeepSeek's Reported $15 Billion Round, Raising Questions About Competitive Landscape
items.summary_zh: 腾讯宁德时代联手，DeepSeek 这 150 亿美元融资意在挑战谁 手机新浪网
items.summary_en: Reports say DeepSeek has closed a round worth about $15 billion, with Tencent and battery maker CATL among the investors. Analysts are debating what the combined internet-and-industrial backing means for the company's competitive position. DeepSeek has not officially confirmed the terms.
items.why_zh: 互联网巨头与制造业龙头同时入场，反映出基础模型公司正成为跨行业资本共同争夺的战略资产。
items.why_en: An internet giant and an industrial leader investing together shows foundation-model firms have become strategic assets pursued across sectors.

items.title_zh: DeepSeek融资近千亿元，宁德时代腾讯参投
items.title_en: DeepSeek Raises Nearly 100 Billion Yuan With CATL and Tencent Participating
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek融资近千亿元，宁德时代腾讯参投 新浪网
items.summary_en: Sina and other outlets report that DeepSeek has raised close to 10 billion yuan, with CATL and Tencent listed among investors. The company has not issued a formal announcement, and details such as equity stakes and use of proceeds remain unclear. Such a sum would likely support large-scale compute and model development.
items.why_zh: 近千亿元的单轮融资规模在国内 AI 行业极为罕见，凸显算力军备竞赛对资金的巨大需求。
items.why_en: A near-10-billion-yuan single round is rare in China's AI industry, underscoring the huge capital demands of the compute race.

items.title_zh: DeepSeek据悉完成1000亿元融资 宁德时代和腾讯参投
items.title_en: DeepSeek Reportedly Completes 100 Billion Yuan Financing With CATL and Tencent
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek据悉完成1000亿元融资 宁德时代和腾讯参投 新浪网
items.summary_en: Reports say DeepSeek has completed a roughly 10 billion yuan funding round with CATL and Tencent taking part. The company has not publicly confirmed the deal. If finalized, it would be a landmark financing event for China's AI model industry.
items.why_zh: 这是中国大模型行业罕见的超大规模单轮融资，可能带动算力与数据中心等上下游产业链。
items.why_en: It is a rare mega-round for China's LLM industry and could lift related compute and data-center supply chains.

items.title_zh: 腾讯宁德时代参投DeepSeek千亿融资
items.title_en: Tencent and CATL Invest in DeepSeek's 100-Billion-Yuan Round
items.summary_zh: 腾讯宁德时代参投DeepSeek千亿融资 新浪网
items.summary_en: Multiple outlets report that Tencent and CATL are participating in a roughly 10 billion yuan round for DeepSeek, though investment amounts and stakes have not been disclosed. The mix of internet platform capital and industrial capital is unusual for Chinese AI financings.
items.why_zh: 投资方兼具互联网平台与制造业资本，显示 AI 大模型正被纳入更广泛的产业战略布局。
items.why_en: The mix of platform and industrial investors shows LLMs are being folded into broader industrial strategy.

items.title_zh: 宇树科技王兴兴：我很害怕浪费每一天，这代人有希望把人形机器人生产力提升到下一个台阶
items.title_en: Unitree's Wang Xingxing: G1 Is World's Best-Selling Humanoid, Self-Evolving Physical AI in Development
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 22 日消息，据新浪科技今日消息，宇树科技创始人王兴兴在 2026 世界物理 AI 大会上发表演讲，回顾公司一年来的进展并分享物理 AI 发展趋势的最新判断。 王兴兴透露， 宇树 G1 是目前全球最畅销的一款人形机器人 ，累计下线约 1 万至 2 万台。谈到 GPT-6 发布对机器人领域的影响时，王兴兴表示，宇树测试显示，在完全零训练的情况下，模型已经能够直接控制机器人完成画画、清洗画笔、下围棋等任务，机器人能自己换颜色、自己清洗画笔，“落子的精准度非常高”。 他判断，未来几年大模型公司对机器智能和机器人产业的关注度将持续提高，“快的话一到两年、慢的话两到三年，行业就有望看到更多进展”。 王兴兴提出，希望未来机器人在完成大约 80% 的任务时，只需要通过语音和语言指令即可完成，“快的话明年有机会实现，稳妥一些可能要到后年”。他指出，目前尚未很好解决的主要是机器人与真实物体之间的交互问题，以及 AI 模型输入、输出与真实机器人之间的对齐问题，其中很大一部分属于工程技术问题。 IT之家从原报道获悉，王兴兴还透露，宇树正在开发“宇树预演”， 即物理 AI 机器人的自进化系统 ，让 AI 模型自己搜集论文、写代码、在仿真环境训练，再到真实环境测试，测试结果由 AI 模型打分并反馈，形成自循环。 演讲结尾， 王兴兴坦言“我真的很害怕浪费每一天” ，并称“我们这一代人真正有…
items.summary_en: At the 2026 World Physical AI Conference, Unitree founder Wang Xingxing said the G1 is the world's best-selling humanoid robot, with about 10,000–20,000 units produced. He said GPT-6 can control robots with zero training to draw, clean brushes and play Go, and predicted more progress in one to three years. Unitree is also developing a self-evolving physical AI system called “Unitree Rehearsal.”
items.why_zh: 人形机器人正从演示走向规模化交付，语音指令控制和自进化系统或成下一阶段关键。
items.why_en: Humanoid robots are moving from demos to scaled delivery, with voice control and self-evolving systems potentially key to the next stage.

items.title_zh: 智谱大跌：较峰值蒸发超1.1万亿港元！DeepSeek 完成 1000亿融资投后估值 6000 亿人民币！
items.title_en: Zhipu Shares Plunge; DeepSeek Raises 100 Billion Yuan
items.summary_zh: 智谱大跌：较峰值蒸发超1.1万亿港元！DeepSeek 完成 1000亿融资投后估值 6000 亿人民币！ finance.sina.com.cn
items.summary_en: Zhipu shares fell sharply, with market value down more than HK$1.1 trillion from its peak, according to reports. Meanwhile, DeepSeek reportedly completed about RMB 100 billion in financing at a post-money valuation of RMB 600 billion. Details on investors and the reason for Zhipu's decline were not disclosed.
items.why_zh: 头部大模型公司的估值与二级市场表现出现明显分化，融资竞赛仍在加速。
items.why_en: Valuations and public-market performance are diverging among leading LLM companies, while the financing race continues to accelerate.

items.title_zh: 英伟达与 6 家上游供应商合作，提升 AI 基础设施产能
items.title_en: Nvidia Partners with Six Suppliers to Expand AI Infrastructure Capacity
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 22 日消息，NVIDIA（英伟达）当地时间本月 21 日宣布与六家供应链合作伙伴一道扩大全球制造能力，以满足市场对其加速计算和全栈人工智能工厂平台日益增长的需求。 这六笔合作关系中的三笔聚焦基板，另外三笔则分别归属先进封装、半导体测试、光封装光学。 NVIDIA 计划在未来 3 年中将其产品所需的基板产能提升至 2.5 倍，这需要上游制造商的配合。 根据日本企业 IBIDEN（揖斐电）今年早些时候公布的协议， NVIDIA 将以数十亿美元的预付款支持该企业日本小野工厂的产能提升 。这次扩建将带来 2 倍的额外产能，预计 2028Q1 起逐步上线。 三星电机 (SEM) 将加入 NVIDIA 的基板供应链 并立即启动出货。本次合作将支持三星电机在世宗、釜山的工厂升级和新建项目。预计到 2028 年，NVIDIA 将在三星电机在封装基板领域的产能中分得相当大部分。 NVIDIA 还以产能预留协议支持欣兴电子 (Unimicron) 的 KF 基板扩产 。该项目预计 2027Q2 开始产能爬升，2028 年满产。 先进封装上， NVIDIA 计划与 Amkor（安靠）合作扩大在韩国先进封装产能 ，目标到 2028 年底将中介层晶圆产能提高 300% 以上。这些新产能和 Amkor 在韩国的新厂建设将支持 NVIDIA 的制造能力提升。 NVIDIA 预计其测试需求将…
items.summary_en: Nvidia announced partnerships with six suppliers to expand global manufacturing for its accelerated computing and AI factory platforms. The deals span substrates, advanced packaging, semiconductor testing and optical packaging, with Nvidia aiming to raise substrate capacity 2.5x over three years. Partners include Ibiden, Samsung Electro-Mechanics, Unimicron and Amkor.
items.why_zh: AI算力需求正把竞争延伸到基板、封装和测试等上游制造环节，产能锁定成为关键。
items.why_en: AI compute demand is extending competition into upstream manufacturing such as substrates, packaging and testing, making capacity reservations critical.

items.title_zh: 科大讯飞首发星火语音基座大模型 SparkAudio 1.0：中英文任意切换、说话人实时识别，输入法里就能用
items.title_en: iFlytek Launches SparkAudio 1.0 Speech Foundation Model
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 22 日消息，在今日下午的科大讯飞全球 1024 开发者节活动中， 科大讯飞宣布首发星火语音基座大模型 SparkAudio 1.0 。 SparkAudio 1.0 集成了 机器翻译、语音识别、语义理解 等能力，显著提升了基础语音能力。 模型宣称在实时说话人分离、环境理解、音频理解、情绪识别等方面“表现卓越”，推动人工智能向物理世界应用迈进。 官方通过一段电影片段的分析，展示了模型对声音内容、背景、说话人性别等的精准识别能力，以及场景判断的准确性。 SparkAudio 1.0 已在 讯飞输入法 16.0 、讯飞听见、讯飞办公本、讯飞翻译机全面上线，支持中英文任意切换、说话人实时识别。 IT之家注意到，科大讯飞还发布了一个“ 讯飞 AI 录音环 ”硬件设备，搭载 4 + 1 环麦阵列、Wi-Fi 6 传输，宣称综合识别准确率超 96%，进行 2 小时的录音转写仅需 2 分钟。
items.summary_en: iFlytek unveiled SparkAudio 1.0, a speech foundation model that integrates machine translation, speech recognition and semantic understanding. It claims strong performance in real-time speaker separation, environmental and audio understanding, and emotion recognition. The model is already available in iFlytek Input 16.0, iFlytek Hearing, its office notebook and translator, supporting Chinese-English switching and real-time speaker recognition.
items.why_zh: 语音基座模型把识别、翻译与场景理解整合起来，有望加速语音AI在办公和硬件中的落地。
items.why_en: A speech foundation model integrating recognition, translation and scene understanding could accelerate voice AI adoption in office tools and hardware.

items.title_zh: 小鹏 GX 累计交付突破 30000 台，将启动中东及全球交付
items.title_en: XPeng GX Deliveries Surpass 30,000, Middle East and Global Rollout Next
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 22 日消息，小鹏汽车今日宣布，小鹏 GX 累计交付突破 30000 台，创小鹏 30 万元均价高端车型最快交付纪录、单车型营收 最快破 100 亿元 纪录。全球市场布局也同步提速，中东区域已收获近 4000 台订单，下一阶段将启动中东及全球交付。 据IT之家此前报道， 小鹏 GX 旗舰 SUV 于今年 5 月 20 日正式上市 。该车提供 纯电、增程 两种不同动力，售价区间为 27.98 万-35.98 万元，限时减免 1 万元。 小鹏 GX 外观设计汲取了游艇灵感，拥有 5265mm x 1999mm x 1800mm 尺寸和 3115mm 的轴距，配备 22 英寸超宽鸳鸯胎；提供珠峰白、极地黑、峡湾灰、丹霞红、云漠金五款配色，以及拂晓白、林雾紫、铂金棕色内饰。 小鹏 GX 搭载 21.4 英寸 3K 吸顶屏（支持智能防夹感应）与 17.3 英寸 120Hz 中控屏，配备行业首个拥有杀菌功能的风冷无霜车载冰箱，支持语音控制冰箱；配备聆境 AI 音响 Max（全车 33 颗扬声器）、翻毛皮顶棚、纳帕真皮内饰、木纹中控及三层氛围灯。 动力方面，小鹏 GX 提供纯电与增程双版本选择。增程版搭载 1.5T 增程器，纯电续航达 430km，综合续航超过 1585km；纯电版基于 800V 高压碳化硅平台，CLTC 续航最高可达 750km，支持 5C 超充技术。全系标…
items.summary_en: XPeng said cumulative deliveries of the GX have surpassed 30,000 units, setting its fastest delivery record for a high-end model with an average price of RMB 300,000. The Middle East has received nearly 4,000 orders, and XPeng will next start Middle East and global deliveries. The GX flagship SUV launched on May 20 with battery-electric and range-extender options.
items.why_zh: 高端车型快速上量并走向海外，显示中国新势力品牌正加速冲击全球中高端市场。
items.why_en: Fast ramp-up of a premium model and overseas expansion show Chinese EV makers are accelerating into the global mid-to-high-end market.

items.title_zh: 富士通客户端计算多系笔电 2026 年冬季上新，提供带光驱型号
items.title_en: Fujitsu Unveils Winter 2026 Laptop Lineup, Some with Optical Drives
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 22 日消息，富士通客户端计算 (FCCL) 今日发布了 2026 年冬季新品阵容，除此前介绍的 FMV Note U 外，C、M、A、Q 几条产品线均有升级。 FMV Note C FMV Note C 是一款 13.3" 型号，新一代产品搭载 AMD 锐龙 AI 7 445，拥有机加工铝材机身，可选地平线蓝和粉金配色。其新增触控支持，强化机身散热，提供 HDMI 输出，支持杜比视界。 ▲ 长场雄联名机身 ▲ 长场雄联名壁纸 ▲ 长场雄联名保护套 除常规型号外，FCCL 还 与艺术家长场雄合作推出了一系列联名款式 。该企业还将发售与 FMV Note C 适配的透明保护套。 ▲ 透明保护套 FMV Note M 新款 FMV Note M 基于第 3 代英特尔酷睿处理器 "Wildcat Lake"，拥有铝制机身，提供双雷电 4、1GbE RJ-45、Wi-Fi 7。 其配备 14.0" 防眩光 LCD 屏幕， 支持电池更换 ，具有符合军用标准的高耐用性。 FMV Note A FMV Note A 是一款很典型的 16.0" 家用笔记本电脑，基于 AMD 锐龙 AI 7 / 5 处理器，提供 3 种配色选项。 其 可选带 DVD Super Multi Drive 光驱版本 ，引入人脸识别摄像头，提供多种 I/O 端口。 FMV Note Q FMV Not…
items.summary_en: Fujitsu Client Computing unveiled its winter 2026 lineup, updating the FMV Note C, M, A and Q series. The 13.3-inch FMV Note C uses an AMD Ryzen AI 7 445, adds touch support and comes in artist collaboration editions. The FMV Note M is based on Intel's third-generation Core “Wildcat Lake” processor, while the 16-inch FMV Note A offers an optional DVD Super Multi Drive.
items.why_zh: 在轻薄本普遍取消光驱的背景下，富士通仍为特定用户保留光驱和可换电池等实用设计。
items.why_en: As most thin laptops drop optical drives, Fujitsu still keeps practical features such as optical drives and replaceable batteries for specific users.

items.title_zh: 讯飞星火 X2.6 端云一体大模型发布，首次基于全国产算力实现代码和智能体能力突破
items.title_en: iFlytek Spark X2.6 Released, Trained on Fully Domestic Compute
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 22 日消息，在今日下午的科大讯飞全球 1024 开发者节活动中， 讯飞星火 X2.6 端云一体大模型正式发布。 讯飞星火 X2.6 宣称 首次基于全国产算力实现代码和智能体能力突破 。科大讯飞董事长刘庆峰表示，只有星火一家是用全国产算力训练的，其他全是在 N 卡上训练，而且科大讯飞的尺寸是最小的。 此外，刘庆峰表示 讯飞星火 X2.6 率先突破国产芯片长程任务的训练效率瓶颈 ，适配国产平台的长程任务动态并行训练技术，解决了因为国产芯片显存带宽限制导致的混合训练效率低下问题。 对于国产算力集群在长程任务上的推理效率，科大讯飞也实现了两个重要创新： 一个是基于国产异构算力的分布式推理技术，解决国产芯片显存带宽限制导致的训不快问题。 另一个是提出基于国产设备的开发技术，很多东西都不用重新再计算，直接用原有结果就可以。 此外， 星火 X2.6-4B 开源端侧大模型正式发布 ，率先实现端侧大模型智能体能力阶跃，相比 X2.5-4B 模型的各项跑分都有明显提升。 IT之家从发布会获悉，9 月 1 日星火 X2.5-4B 端侧模型开源以来， 下载量已进入全球端侧模型前四 。 讯飞星火 X2.6 系列模型现已在讯飞星火官网开放试用，首发星火大模型端云一体协同架构。 讯飞星火 X2.6 基于国产算力完成训练， 采用 293B-A30B 参数的 MoE 架构 ，上下文长度拓展至…
items.summary_en: iFlytek released Spark X2.6, an end-cloud integrated model that it says is the first to achieve code and agent capability breakthroughs trained entirely on domestic compute. Chairman Liu Qingfeng said Spark is the only model trained on fully domestic compute and has the smallest model size. items.title_zh: 工信部 NVDB 发布关于防范 PHP 远程代码执行超危漏洞的风险提示
items.title_en: China's NVDB warns of two ultra-critical PHP RCE vulnerabilities
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 22 日消息，近日，工业和信息化部网络安全威胁和漏洞信息共享平台（NVDB）监测发现，PHP 存在两个远程代码执行超危漏洞，危害严重。 PHP 是一款广泛用于 Web 开发的开源服务器端脚本语言。由于其存在两个超危远程代码执行漏洞，未经身份验证的攻击者可利用其远程执行任意代码，造成服务器受控、敏感信息泄露、业务中断等危害。受影响的 PHP 范围包括：8.5 系列＜8.5.12、8.4 系列＜8.4.27、8.3 系列＜8.3.36、8.2 系列＜8.2.35、8.1 系列及更早版本。 目前，PHP 安全团队已修复漏洞并发布安全公告（URL 链接： https://www.php.net/ archive/ 2026.php#2026-10-21-5 ）。建议相关单位和用户立即开展全面排查，及时升级至最新安全版本，或采取临时下线、关闭会话上传进度功能、网络隔离、网络访问限制等临时防护措施；加强网络安全监测和管理，及时修改账号、口令和密钥等凭证，防范网络攻击风险。 相关阅读： 《 影响约 70% 网站：PHP 高危漏洞被修复，OpenAI 牵头协调全球发现 / 修复 》 《 为预防 PHP 安全漏洞，芬兰政府临时关闭部分网站 》 《 PHP 将推补丁修复两个 9.2 分漏洞，欧盟敦促无法及时修复的机构下线受影响网站 》 《 9.2 评分：PHP 拉响安全警报，今天将…
items.summary_en: China's MIIT NVDB issued a risk alert over two ultra-critical PHP remote code execution vulnerabilities that allow unauthenticated attackers to run arbitrary code, potentially leading to server takeover, sensitive data leaks and service disruption. Affected versions include PHP 8.5 before 8.5.12, 8.4 before 8.4.27, 8.3 before 8.3.36, 8.2 before 8.2.35, and 8.1 and earlier. PHP has released fixes; NVDB urges immediate patching or temporary mitigations such as taking services offline, disabling session upload progress, network isolation and access restrictions.
items.why_zh: PHP 广泛用于 Web 开发，超危 RCE 漏洞可能影响大量服务器，需尽快升级或采取临时防护。
items.why_en: PHP is widely used in web development, so ultra-critical RCE flaws could affect many servers and require urgent patching or mitigation.

items.title_zh: 5 年内产量翻番：马斯克称特斯拉目标 2030 实现年产量破 500 万辆

items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 22 日消息，科技媒体 breakingthenews 今天（10 月 22 日）发布博文，报道称在最新财报电话会议上，特斯拉首席执行官埃隆 · 马斯克（Elon Musk）表示， 公司有望在 2030 年实现年产量突破 500 万辆。 马斯克表示特斯拉“已经为更大规模制造能力打下基础”，并认为“有很好的机会实现这一目标”。IT之家援引博文介绍，根据特斯拉第三季度财报资料， 公司目前年产能约为 240 万辆 ；若 2030 年达到 500 万辆，相当于产能翻倍。 马斯克强调，当前特斯拉车辆需求“正在快速增长”，并且“明显超过产能”。公司正在通过提升现有工厂生产节奏、扩建柏林工厂、在得州推进 Cybercab 量产，以及启动新的 Semi 工厂等方式增加产能。 财报电话会还披露，特斯拉第三季度交付 486,532 辆汽车，管理层称交付主要受产能而非需求限制，未交付订单积压达到近四年高位。马斯克将需求增长部分归因于完全自动驾驶（FSD）软件，并称公司将继续推动 FSD 在欧洲等更多市场获得批准。
items.summary_en: Elon Musk said on Tesla's earnings call that the company could reach annual production of more than 5 million vehicles by 2030, roughly double its current capacity of about 2.4 million. Tesla is expanding output by speeding up existing plants, expanding Berlin, ramping Cybercab in Texas and building a new Semi factory. Q3 deliveries reached 486,532 units, with management saying output rather than demand was the constraint and the order backlog hitting a near four-year high.
items.why_zh: 产量翻番目标将检验特斯拉的制造扩张能力，也反映其押注FSD带动需求增长。
items.why_en: The doubling target will test Tesla's manufacturing scale-up and reflects its bet that FSD will help drive demand.

items.summary_en: Sohu and other outlets report that DeepSeek raised 100 billion yuan in its latest round, possibly the largest AI fundraising in China, with Tencent and CATL among investors. Full terms were not disclosed, and neither DeepSeek nor the investors have officially announced the deal.
items.why_zh: 若消息坐实，将刷新中国AI融资纪录，并进一步抬升头部大模型的资本门槛。
items.why_en: If confirmed, the deal would set a Chinese AI funding record and raise the capital bar for leading foundation-model players.

Details remain unconfirmed by the company. The scale could reshape DeepSeek's compute capacity and raise the capital bar for China's model race.
items.why_zh: 融资规模刷新国内 AI 纪录，将直接影响 DeepSeek 的算力与模型迭代能力，并抬高行业竞争门槛。
items.why_en: A record-setting round would directly boost DeepSeek's compute and model roadmap while raising the capital threshold for rivals.

items.why_zh: 被称为中国 AI 最大融资，其资金转化效率将直接影响国内大模型竞争格局。
items.why_en: Billed as China's largest AI round, how efficiently the capital converts into compute and models will shape the domestic competitive landscape.

items.title_zh: LG Display 今年 Q3 归母净利润 7467.47 亿韩元，单季同比扭亏为盈

items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 22 日消息，LG Display 今日发布 2026 财年（2026 年 1 月～2026 年 12 月）第三财季（2026 年 7 月～2026 年 9 月）业绩快报报告： 营业总收入 ：6.28 万亿韩元，同比下降 10%，环比增长 12% 归母净利润： 7467.47 亿韩元，同比扭亏为盈 合并净利润： 7556.35 亿韩元，同比增长 60496% 营业利润： 2505.68 亿韩元，同比下降 42%，环比扭亏为盈 AI 解读 本次财报业绩符合市场预期，归母净利润大幅同比增长超出市场预期。 公司主营业务说明 LG Display 是全球领先的显示面板制造商，主要生产 LCD、OLED 显示面板，产品应用于电视、笔记本电脑、显示器、汽车电子、移动设备等领域。 本次财报核心业绩亮点 营业收入：6.28 万亿韩元，环比增长 12%，同比下降 10%。 归属于母公司股东的净利润：7467.47 亿韩元，去年同期亏损 206.58 亿韩元，同比扭亏为盈； 合并净利润：7556.35 亿韩元，同比增长 60496%，去年同期为 12.47 亿韩元。 营业利润：第三季度营业利润为 2505.68 亿韩元，同比下降 42%，上季度亏损 1077.28 亿韩元，环比扭亏为盈。 未来展望与信息披露安排 本次业绩为初步快报数据，最终数据可能存在调整，业绩说明会已于 2026…
items.summary_en: LG Display reported preliminary Q3 FY2026 results: revenue of KRW 6.28 trillion, down 10% YoY but up 12% QoQ; net profit attributable to shareholders of KRW 746.747 billion, turning profitable from a year-earlier loss; consolidated net profit of KRW 755.635 billion; and operating profit of KRW 250.568 billion, down 42% YoY but turning profitable QoQ. The company said results met market expectations, with attributable net profit beating expectations; final figures may be adjusted.
items.why_zh: 财报显示 LG Display 同比扭亏为盈，反映显示面板行业盈利修复与公司经营改善。
items.why_en: The swing to profitability signals improving earnings in the display panel sector and better operating performance at LG Display.

items.title_zh: StochIKM：从已发表 Kaplan-Meier 曲线自动高保真重建个体患者数据
items.title_en: StochIKM: Automated High-Fidelity Reconstruction of Individual Patient Data from Published Kaplan-Meier Curves
items.summary_zh: arXiv 论文提出 StochIKM，用于从已发表的 Kaplan-Meier 生存曲线自动重建个体患者数据（IPD）。作者指出，现有方法虽都宣称高保真，但各自采用不同的一致性标准，并且只返回单一数据集，而图像到数据的映射并非一一对应。论文明确给出“可采纳数据集”的保真度定义：需精确复现风险表、在图像分辨率范围内贴合数字化曲线，并满足其他约束（摘要在此处截断）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.29122v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Individual patient data are the gold standard for secondary analysis of time-to-event evidence, but they are rarely released, and reconstruction from a published Kaplan-Meier figure could help. Existing methods all claim high fidelity, each judged by whichever agreements it happens to achieve, and each returns a single dataset although the map from figure to data is not bijective. We define fidelity explicitly: a dataset is admissible when it reproduces the risk table exactly, follows the digitized curve to within the image resolution, and respec…
items.why_zh: IPD 是生存分析二次研究的金标准，自动化重建可提升证据合成与可复现性。
items.why_en: IPD is the gold standard for secondary survival analysis, and automated reconstruction can improve evidence synthesis and reproducibility.

items.title_zh: CompLit：科研文献检索基准必须覆盖隐含、累积与未满足需求
items.title_en: CompLit: Scientific Literature Search Benchmarks Must Cover Implicit, Cumulative, and Unmet Needs
items.summary_zh: arXiv 论文指出，科研人员检索文献时往往用自身语言描述需求，论文可能只隐含地体现这些需求；随着阅读深入，需求会累积增长；而真正想找的内容还可能处于尚无论文覆盖的空白区域。为此，作者提出 CompLit 基准，覆盖 arXiv 八个领域，并为隐含、累积和未满足需求分别设置诊断场景。论文还评估了 Codex（GPT-5.6-Sol）与 Claude Code（Opus 4.8）等最强 agent，摘要在此处截断，未给出完整结果。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.28658v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: How much can we trust an agent to find the paper we need? As researchers, we search the literature from what we have read toward what we have not. We thus describe what we want in our own terms, which a paper may show only implicitly; our requirements grow as we read; and what we seek may lie in an empty region no paper yet covers. We introduce CompLit, a literature search benchmark spanning all eight arXiv domains, with one diagnostic setting for each of these needs. The strongest agents, Codex (GPT-5.6-Sol) and Claude Code (Opus 4.8), answer…
items.why_zh: 更真实的文献检索基准能检验 AI 科研助手是否理解研究意图，而非只做关键词匹配。
items.why_en: More realistic literature-search benchmarks test whether AI research assistants understand research intent rather than merely matching keywords.

items.title_zh: VHDLBench：面向VHDL芯片设计的大模型评测与微调基准
items.title_en: VHDLBench: Benchmarking and Fine-Tuning Large Language Models for VHDL-Based Chip Design
items.summary_zh: 随着数字电路复杂度快速攀升，硬件设计自动化亟需新方法，但大语言模型在硬件描述语言生成、尤其是VHDL上的应用仍少有探索。该论文构建了包含1.85万余条经语法校验样本的VHDL数据集，数据取自开源代码仓库，并在此基础上系统评测与微调LLM，用于AI辅助数字电路设计。研究填补了当前电子设计自动化（EDA）流程中LLM能力评估的空白。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.28676v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The rapid evolution of digital circuit complexity demands innovative approaches to hardware design automation. While Large Language Models (LLMs) have influenced software development, their application to Hardware Description Language (HDL) generation remains largely unexplored, particularly for VHDL. This paper presents a comprehensive study for AI-assisted digital circuit design, addressing gaps in current Electronic Design Automation workflows. The work introduces a VHDL dataset of 18,500+ syntax-verified examples from open-source repositori…
items.why_zh: 为LLM进入芯片前端设计这一高价值场景提供了可复现的数据与评测基础。
items.why_en: It provides a reproducible data and evaluation foundation for applying LLMs to chip front-end design.

items.title_zh: 面向临床与可穿戴健康数据的单位感知差分隐私量子机器学习
items.title_en: Unit-Aware Differentially Private Quantum Machine Learning for Clinical and Wearable Health Data
items.summary_zh: 临床登记数据与可穿戴传感器有助于早期健康风险评估，但在这些记录上训练的模型一旦发布，可能泄露敏感信息。差分隐私通过注入噪声来限制泄露，然而噪声总量随可训练参数增加而上升，对样本量小的健康队列尤为不利。这促使研究者转向量子机器学习等参数高效模型——其变分电路可用较少参数刻画复杂决策边界。论文据此探讨单位感知的差分隐私量子机器学习方法。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.28968v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Clinical registries and wearable sensors support early health-risk assessment, yet models trained on these records may leak sensitive information when released. Differential privacy (DP) bounds this leakage by injecting noise whose total magnitude grows with the number of trainable parameters, a cost especially severe for small health cohorts. This motivates parameter efficient models including quantum machine learning (QML), whose variational circuits can represent complex decision boundaries with few trainable parameters. It raises a question…
items.why_zh: 在小样本健康数据上，为隐私保护与模型效用之间的权衡提供了新思路。
items.why_en: It offers a new direction for balancing privacy and utility when modeling small health cohorts.

items.title_zh: 混合CNN-Transformer与知识自蒸馏提升香蕉品种跨等级分类泛化
items.title_en: Enhancing Cross-Grade Generalization in Banana Variety Classification via Hybrid CNN-Transformers and Knowledge Self-Distillation
items.summary_zh: 在精准农业中，自动化水果分类已成为产量估计、质量控制和供应链优化的重要环节，但在品质差异、成熟度不同、光照变化、纹理退化、形态属性以及采后处理带来的域偏移下仍面临明显挑战。该研究聚焦真实场景中的跨等级香蕉品种分类问题，提出融合CNN与Transformer的混合架构，并结合知识自蒸馏，以提升模型在不同等级之间的泛化能力。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.29008v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In recent years, automated fruit classification systems have become a more critical component in precision agriculture for efficient yield estimation, quality control, and supply chain optimization. However, they still face significant challenges under varying quality, fruit maturity, illumination, texture degradation, morphological attributes, domain shift, and post-harvest handling conditions. In this study, we address the challenging issue of cross-grade banana variety classification. This is a real-world setting where models that have been…
items.why_zh: 跨等级泛化是农业视觉模型落地时常见却被忽视的关键难点。
items.why_en: Cross-grade generalization is an overlooked but critical hurdle for deploying agricultural vision models.

items.title_zh: Huayu-Global：实时准全球降水反演系统
items.title_en: Huayu-Global: Skillful real-time quasi-global precipitation retrieval
items.summary_zh: 卫星降水产品长期面临两难：实时估计及时但精度较低，而最可靠的产品往往在观测数月后才发布，使高质量降水信息错过洪水预警与灾害响应的决策窗口。研究者提出Huayu-Global——一个跨星座深度学习系统，通过统一反演框架融合来自五颗卫星的三类静止轨道传感器数据流，生成时间一致的准全球降水场。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.29213v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Satellite precipitation products face a persistent trade-off: real-time estimates are timely but less accurate, whereas the most reliable products are often released months after observation. This delay keeps high-quality precipitation information outside the decision window for flood warning and disaster response. Here we report Huayu-Global, a cross-constellation deep-learning system that combines three geostationary sensor streams from five satellites through a common retrieval framework and generates coherent quasi-global precipitation fiel…
items.why_zh: 把高质量降水估计拉进实时决策窗口，对洪水预警具有直接价值。
items.why_en: It brings high-quality precipitation estimates into real-time decision windows, directly benefiting flood warning.

items.title_zh: 大模型为何爱推荐AI？微调数据与流程或是源头
items.title_en: Where Do LLMs Learn to Recommend AI?
items.summary_zh: 当被问及该学什么、从事什么职业或做什么产品时，大语言模型常给出与AI相关的建议。研究者通过对比微调前后的模型并改变提问方式，追溯这一倾向的来源：预训练模型已有27%的回答明确包含AI/ML术语，公开的指令微调版本这一比例升至59%。但作者自行微调后发现，这种上升并非必然——通用指令微调并未带来相同的提升。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.29785v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Asked what to study, which career to pursue, or what product to build, large language models (LLMs) often recommend AI-related options. We ask where this tendency comes from by comparing models before and after fine-tuning and by varying how questions are asked. First, pretrained models already include explicit AI/ML terms in the recommendations of 27% of their responses, and their released instruction-tuned versions do so in 59%. Second, fine-tuning models ourselves shows that this rise is not inevitable: general instruction tuning leaves the…
items.why_zh: 表明模型的推荐偏好可能源于微调数据与流程，而非模型能力本身。
items.why_en: It suggests recommendation bias may stem from fine-tuning data and pipelines rather than capability itself.

items.title_zh: 每条告警皆有原因：可生成带精确根因的电信告警风暴开源工具
items.title_en: Every Alarm Has a Cause: An Open Generator of Telecom Alarm Storms with Exact Root Causes, Bound to NORIA-O, RFC 8632 and TMF642
items.summary_zh: 告警根因分析研究长期受制于数据不可共享：运营商日志属机密，公开的往往只是告警类型之间的因果图，而非逐条事件的真实根因，或仅有固定场景、需审批甚至从不发布。为此，作者不提供数据集，而是给出一个生成器：它在Internet Topology Zoo的真实骨干拓扑上运行，记录每条告警的确切根因与传播路径，并与NORIA-O、RFC 8632及TMF642标准对齐。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.30004v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Alarm root-cause analysis is studied on data that cannot be shared. Operator logs are confidential, so what the field publishes is a causal graph between alarm types rather than per-incident causes, a fixed scenario set, gated, or never released. Two recent benchmarks carry per-incident root causes at scale; neither states a download location or a licence. We give a generator rather than a dataset. It runs on real backbone topologies from the Internet Topology Zoo and records the exact root cause and the propagation path of every alarm -- a by-…
items.why_zh: 以可生成的合成告警风暴绕开数据保密壁垒，为根因分析提供带精确标注的可复现数据。
items.why_en: A generator with exact labels sidesteps confidentiality barriers and enables reproducible root-cause research.

items.title_zh: CTBench：评估AI智能体在真实电信网络运维中的排障能力
items.title_en: CTBench: Evaluating Troubleshooting Capabilities of AI Agents in Realistic Telecom Network Operations
items.summary_zh: 自主智能体在网络运维中展现出潜力，但现有电信故障排查评测难以反映真实环境的部分可观测性与异构性。作者提出CTBench——一个由领域专家构建的公开基准，用于评估智能体在根因分析与路径恢复两类任务上的表现。该基准提供丰富的元数据与“黄金证据轨迹”，其指标同时考察最终结果的准确性与诊断推理过程。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.12002v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: While autonomous agents show promise for network operations, existing telecom troubleshooting evaluations fail to capture the partial observability and heterogeneity of real-world telecom environments. We introduce CTBench, a public benchmark evaluating agent troubleshooting capabilities in root cause analysis (RCA) and path restoration. Constructed by domain experts, CTBench features rich metadata and golden evidence trajectories, utilizing metrics that assess both final accuracy and diagnostic reasoning. Our evaluation of state-of-the-art a…
items.why_zh: 把评测从“是否答对”扩展到诊断推理过程，更贴近真实网络运维。
items.why_en: It evaluates diagnostic reasoning, not just final answers, better reflecting real network operations.

items.title_zh: StructLens：用最大生成树为语言模型提供结构视角
items.title_en: StructLens: A Structural Lens for Language Models via Maximum Spanning Trees
items.summary_zh: 语言本身具有结构，这既解释了语言习得，也解释了语言演变，因此语言模型内部也可能呈现自身的结构。以往可解释性研究多通过注意力模式和稀疏自编码器，从机制层面考察模型如何计算表征，却忽视了这些表征的组织方式。为填补这一空白，作者提出StructLens框架，借助最大生成树从整体结构视角分析模型表征。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2603.03328v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Language exhibits inherent structures, a property that explains both language acquisition and language change. Given this characteristic, we expect language models to manifest their own internal structures as well. While interpretability research has investigated how models compute representations mechanistically through attention patterns and Sparse AutoEncoders, the organization of the resulting representations is overlooked. To address this gap, we introduce StructLens, a framework to analyze representations through a holistic struct…
items.why_zh: 从“如何计算”转向“如何组织”，为模型可解释性补上结构视角。
items.why_en: It adds a structural perspective to interpretability, complementing mechanistic accounts of computation.

items.title_zh: 引用在偏好数据中的作用
items.title_en: On the Role of Citations in Preference Data
items.summary_zh: 这篇论文研究了“引用”在模型输出评价中的作用。作者指出，许多 NLP 任务要求系统给出归因，即标注输出所依据的来源，引用既能抑制模型幻觉，也方便用户核实输出可信度；但在比较两个输出优劣时，人类评审和大模型究竟如何看待引用，目前并不清楚，而这一过程正是奖励建模与现代 LLM 后训练的核心。研究在科学问答场景下，考察了人类评审与四个开源 LLM 在做偏好判断时对引用的重视程度。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.21376v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Many NLP tasks require systems to provide attribution in their outputs--i.e. citations to grounding sources. Attribution serves as a bulwark against model hallucination and as a means for users to verify the credibility of model outputs. Yet, it is unclear how humans and LLMs evaluate citations when comparing outputs, a process central to reward modeling and modern LLM post-training. This paper studies the role of citations in the preferences of human judges and four open-source LLMs within the context of scientific question answering,…
items.why_zh: 偏好数据是奖励建模与后训练的基石，厘清引用在其中的权重，有助于设计更可靠的归因与评测机制。
items.why_en: Preference data underpins reward modeling and post-training, so understanding how citations shape preferences matters for building reliable attribution and evaluation.

items.title_zh: 症状到疾病分类需要一个 9B 决策基座模型吗？Clef-Flash 微调与 TF-IDF 基线对比
items.title_en: Is a 9B Decision Foundation Model Needed for Symptom-to-Disease Classification? Fine-Tuning Clef-Flash Against TF-IDF Baselines
items.summary_zh: 论文关注如何根据患者自述症状描述做疾病分类。常见做法要么是轻量判别模型，要么是自回归大模型；后者语言理解广，但逐 token 生成文本、还需解析输出。作者转而研究“决策基座模型”：在一次前向传播中为封闭候选标签打分，无需生成文本。他们把基于 Qwen3.5 主干、拥有 90 亿参数的 Clef-Flash 适配到 24 类的 Symptom2Disease 基准上，并与 TF-IDF 类基线进行比较。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.15029v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Disease classification from patient-reported symptom descriptions is usually approached with lightweight discriminative models or with autoregressive large language models (LLMs), which understand language broadly but generate text token by token and require output parsing. We study decision foundation models, which score a closed set of candidate labels in a single forward pass without generating text. We adapt Clef-Flash, a 9-billion parameter decision model built on a Qwen3.5 backbone, to the 24-class Symptom2Disease benchmark using…
items.why_zh: 它检验了在症状分诊这类封闭标签任务上，大参数决策模型是否真的优于廉价基线，为实际部署选型提供依据。
items.why_en: It tests whether a large decision foundation model actually beats cheap baselines on closed-label tasks like symptom triage, informing deployment choices.

items.title_zh: 大声明、小差距：GraphLLM 报告的提升能否经受简单基线检验？
items.title_en: Big Claims, Small Margins: Do Reported GraphLLM Gains Survive Simple Baselines?
items.summary_zh: 基于 LLM 的文本属性图（TAG）节点分类方法常宣称达到 SOTA。作者在近期三项研究使用的相同数据划分上，用仅依赖验证集的方式调优四个代表性基线，再与各论文在匹配设置下报告的 LLM 方法最高平均成绩对比。结果显示：在 TF-IDF 特征上运行 Correct & Smooth，中位数仅落后该参照 2.3 个百分点；在冻结的 e5-large-v2 特征上训练 MLP 也表现接近。这提示 GraphLLM 的领先幅度可能被高估。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.28714v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: LLM-based methods for node classification on text-attributed graphs (TAGs) routinely report state-of-the-art accuracy. We ask how these results compare with inexpensive baselines run on the same splits. On the splits of three recent studies, we tune four baseline representatives with validation-only selection and compare them with the highest mean that each paper reports for an LLM-based method in the matched setting. Correct & Smooth on TF-IDF features trails this reference by a median of 2.3 percentage points, and an MLP on frozen e5-large-v2 e…
items.why_zh: 它提醒社区：缺乏强基线的对比容易夸大 LLM 在图学习上的进展，评测规范亟需收紧。
items.why_en: It cautions that missing strong baselines can inflate reported LLM gains on graphs, highlighting the need for stricter evaluation practices.

items.title_zh: 用知识重铸对抗持续域适应中的灾难性遗忘
items.title_en: Combating Catastrophic Forgetting in Continual Domain Adaptation via Knowledge Recasting
items.summary_zh: 把语言模型后训练到新领域，可能损害其原有能力，即灾难性遗忘。现有缓解方法多把遗忘视为模型漂移过度的结果，因而通过保留旧输出、回放旧数据或正则化参数与表示来约束更新，使新模型尽量接近旧状态。作者提出不同视角：不是把模型拉回旧状态，而是通过“知识重铸”的思路重新组织已有能力。论文在持续域适应场景下验证该方法对遗忘的抑制效果。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.28892v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Adapting language models to new domains during post-training risks degrading previously acquired capabilities, a phenomenon commonly known as catastrophic forgetting. Existing mitigation methods largely treat forgetting as a consequence of excessive model drift. They therefore constrain updates by preserving old outputs, replaying old data, or regularizing changes to parameters and representations so that the updated model remains close to its previous state. We take a different view: Rather than pulling the updated model back toward its old stat…
items.why_zh: 为模型持续适配新领域时保留旧能力提供了不同于“约束漂移”的新思路。
items.why_en: It offers a new angle beyond drift-constraining for retaining old capabilities while adapting models to new domains.

items.title_zh: FlashNext-RL：面向 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 长程智能体强化学习的系统优化
items.title_en: FlashNext-RL: A System Optimization Study for Long-Horizon Agentic RL of Qwen3.8-Flash-Next
items.summary_zh: 长程智能体强化学习既需要高效的 rollout 生成，又要在长序列上训练，但 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 的内存需求和专属算子让现有开源实现难以胜任。为此作者提出 FlashNext-RL：一个基于 prime-rl 的模型定制化 RL 训练优化框架，并用 vLLM 负责软件工程（SWE）任务的 rollout 生成。工作重点是单台 8xB200 节点上对完整 48 层模型进行 BF16 训练。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.28998v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Long-horizon agentic reinforcement learning (RL) requires both efficient rollout generation and training on long sequences. However, the memory requirements and model-specific operators of Qwen3.8-Flash-Next make this difficult with existing open-source implementations. To resolve these limitations, we introduce FlashNext-RL, a model-specific RL training optimization framework based on prime-rl, with vLLM for software engineering (SWE) rollout generation. Our main focus is BF16 training of the full 48-layer model on a single 8xB200 node, with the…
items.why_zh: 它给出在有限硬件上训练大型智能体 RL 的可行工程路径，对智能体训练落地具有参考价值。
items.why_en: It shows a practical engineering path for running large agentic RL training on limited hardware.

items.title_zh: 隐藏学习结构的动力学
items.title_en: Dynamics of Hidden Learning Structure
items.summary_zh: 学习器当前的预测并不能完全决定它接下来会如何学习。论文通过两个相互关联的操作来研究“隐藏学习结构”的动力学。其一是纤维调节理论（FRT），描述对既有功能的受保护修复，以及修复后仍可用的学习响应；其二是纤维获取理论（FAT），描述可训练结构的形成与更新，区分中性安装、获得学习信号以及新增功能方向。两种操作彼此约束：例如一次修复会影响后续可获取的结构。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.29054v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A learner's present predictions do not fully determine how it will learn next. We study the dynamics of hidden learning structure through two related operations. Fiber Regulation Theory (FRT) describes protected repair of existing function and the learning responses left available after repair. Fiber Acquisition Theory (FAT) describes the formation and renewal of trainable structure, distinguishing neutral installation, access to a learning signal, and additional functional directions. The two operations also constrain one another. A repair oblig…
items.why_zh: 它试图从理论上刻画“预测之外”的学习动力学，为理解模型如何继续学习提供新框架。
items.why_en: It offers a theoretical framework for learning dynamics that go beyond current predictions.

items.title_zh: 刻画无感知共同奖励多玩家老虎机：普适平稳性、协调陷阱与可证全局速率
items.title_en: Characterizing Oblivious Common-Reward Multi-Player Bandits: Universal Stationarity, Coordination Traps, and Certified Global Rates
items.summary_zh: 论文对“无感知共同奖励多玩家多臂老虎机”（OC-MPMAB）进行理论分析。这是极简的多玩家老虎机模型：多个玩家同时选择臂，但只能观测到一个共享奖励；关键在于玩家完全无感知——看不到他人的动作，甚至不知道是否存在其他玩家。作者给出三方面贡献，其中包括证明各玩家独立执行的梯度老虎机更新会共同构成一个无偏的随机过程，并讨论了协调陷阱与可证的全局收敛速率。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.29673v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper presents a theoretical analysis of the oblivious common-reward multi-player multi-armed bandit (OC-MPMAB), a minimal multi-player bandit model in which multiple players select arms simultaneously and observe only a shared reward. Crucially, the players are fully oblivious: they do not observe the actions of other players and do not even know whether any other players exist. The contributions of this work are threefold. First, we prove that the independent gradient-bandit updates applied by the players jointly form an unbiased stochasti…
items.why_zh: 为去中心化多智能体学习中的协调与收敛问题提供了严格的理论刻画。
items.why_en: It provides rigorous theory on coordination and convergence in decentralized multi-agent learning.

items.title_zh: FrontierCS 2：面向计算机科学研发的基准
items.title_en: FrontierCS 2: A Benchmark for Computer Science R&D
items.summary_zh: 论文提出 FrontierCS 2，用于检验 LLM 智能体能否对前沿计算机科学研究与开发做出贡献。该基准包含 48 个开放式任务：取一篇论文及其作者公开的代码，删去论文的核心贡献，被删掉的代码即成为人类参考标准。与以往只给问题描述、跑完后评一个程序的开放式基准不同，FrontierCS 2 把智能体置于研究环境中：它继承一个可运行的代码仓库，可在任意时刻提交补丁，每个补丁由评审给出反馈。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.29932v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Can LLM agents make contributions to frontier computer science R&D? We introduce FrontierCS 2, a benchmark of 48 open-ended tasks. We take a paper and the code its authors released and delete the paper's contribution. The deleted code becomes the human reference that sets the bar. Earlier open-ended benchmarks give each agent a problem statement and grade one program after the run. FrontierCS 2 places the agent inside a research environment. The agent inherits a working repository and may submit a patch at any point. For each patch, a judge retur…
items.why_zh: 它把评测从“写一个程序”推进到“在真实研究环境中迭代改进”，更贴近前沿科研的实际形态。
items.why_en: It moves evaluation from one-shot program writing to iterative work inside a real research environment, closer to actual frontier R&D.

items.title_zh: 理解限价订单簿状态空间基础模型的内部机制
items.title_en: Understanding the Inner Workings of a State-Space Foundation Model for Limit Order Books
items.summary_zh: 该论文关注用于限价订单簿（LOB）的自回归基础模型：这类模型能通过生成订单消息流来模拟市场，但其内部机制尚不清楚，既难以聚焦研究方向，也影响其在真实交易环境中的落地。作者因此追问模型究竟学到了哪些市场微观结构，并以一个约820万参数的 Mamba-3 状态空间模型为对象展开分析。研究发现，与序列模型在棋类游戏中构建内部“棋盘”表示类似，该模型也会形成对市场的内部表征。论文进一步讨论这些表示对理解模型行为及实际应用的意义。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.28753v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Autoregressive foundation models offer state-of-the-art capabilities to simulate the market by generating the message flow of limit order books (LOBs). Yet, without understanding their inner workings, research directions are hard to narrow and practical use in real-world trading environments remains uncertain. This study therefore asks what these models actually learn about market microstructure. We find that, similarly to games where sequence models build an internal representation of the board, an 8.2M-parameter Mamba-3 state-space model trai…
items.why_zh: 理解金融市场基础模型的内部表示，是评估其可靠性并推动实盘应用的关键。
items.why_en: Understanding what market-generating foundation models learn internally is key to assessing their reliability and enabling real-world trading use.

items.title_zh: pplx-embed-v2-late 技术报告：0.6B 与 9B 多语言多模态嵌入模型
items.title_en: pplx-embed-v2-late Technical Report
items.summary_zh: 该技术报告发布 pplx-embed-v2-late，包括 0.6B 与 9B 两个多语言、多模态的晚交互（late-interaction）嵌入模型。两者在各自参数规模档的文本、图像和视觉文档检索基准上均取得领先结果；其中 0.6B 版本在视觉文档检索任务上可与数倍于自身规模的模型竞争。模型通过从 18B 教师模型进行表示蒸馏训练，因而共享同一嵌入空间，支持非对称部署。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.29523v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In this report, we introduce pplx-embed-v2-late, a pair of 0.6B and 9B multilingual and multimodal late-interaction models. Both models achieve state-of-the-art results within their respective size classes across a range of text, image, and visual document retrieval benchmarks. On visual document retrieval tasks, pplx-embed-v2-late-0.6b is competitive with models several times larger than itself. The models are trained via representation distillation from an 18B teacher. Consequently, they share an embedding space that supports asymmetric deplo…
items.why_zh: 更小却更强的多模态检索嵌入模型可降低部署成本，并支持大小模型协同的非对称检索架构。
items.why_en: Stronger yet smaller multimodal retrieval embeddings can lower deployment costs and enable asymmetric retrieval with shared embedding spaces.

items.title_zh: 大语言模型量化技术的全面评估
items.title_en: A Comprehensive Evaluation on Quantization Techniques for Large Language Models
items.summary_zh: 该综述聚焦大语言模型（LLM）的训练后量化（PTQ），这一技术可显著降低内存与计算开销。作者指出，现有研究往往缺乏在同一实验条件下的对比，且量化方案通常由多个组件构成，需要厘清各种方法之间的联系。为此，论文对当前最先进方法进行了最新且广泛的梳理，并开展全面评估，以弥补上述空白。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2507.17417v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: For large language models (LLMs), post-training quantization (PTQ) significantly reduces memory and computational overhead. Despite rapid advancements, existing papers often lack experiments on the same ground. In addition, since quantization solutions typically contain multiple components, it is important to analyze the connections among numerous existing methods to gain an in-depth understanding of this field. To bridge these gaps, we conduct an up-to-date and extensive review of the state-of-the-art methods and perform comprehensive evalua…
items.why_zh: 量化是 LLM 落地的关键降本手段，统一基准与系统评估有助于研究者和工程师选择可靠方案。
items.why_en: Quantization is a key cost-reduction lever for LLM deployment; unified benchmarks and systematic evaluation help practitioners choose reliable methods.

items.title_zh: 经验去噪器的隐私核算
items.title_en: Privacy Accounting for Empirical Denoisers
items.summary_zh: 扩散模型是现代生成系统的基础，但其强大的记忆能力带来隐私风险。差分隐私（DP）训练可提供形式化保证，却会牺牲样本质量。本文研究一个互补问题：采样过程本身会带来多少隐私损失。由于现代神经去噪器对单个训练样本的敏感度通常难以直接分析，作者通过构造可分析的去噪器来克服这一难题，并给出面向经验去噪器的隐私核算方法。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.27710v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Diffusion models have emerged as the foundation of modern generative systems, yet their high memorization capacity raises privacy concerns. While differentially private (DP) training provides formal guarantees, it comes at a cost in sample quality. In this work, we study a complementary question: how much privacy loss is incurred during the sampling process itself? Directly analyzing modern neural denoisers is challenging because their sensitivity to a single training example is generally intractable. To overcome this challenge, we construct…
items.why_zh: 将隐私风险从训练扩展到采样阶段，有助于更完整地评估生成式模型的实际泄露风险。
items.why_en: Extending privacy risk analysis from training to sampling gives a more complete picture of real-world leakage in generative models.

items.title_zh: 利用凹性信息的高斯过程上下文赌博机优化
items.title_en: Exploiting Concavity Information in Gaussian Process Contextual Bandit Optimization
items.summary_zh: 上下文赌博机（contextual bandit）用于建模奖励同时取决于所选动作和观测上下文的序贯决策问题。在医学、商业和工程等领域，先验知识常提供奖励函数的结构信息，可用于提升优化效率。本文研究在每个可观测上下文下，条件平均奖励关于动作变量已知为凹函数的情形，并据此开发上下文赌博机算法，以利用凹性结构加速优化。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2503.10836v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The contextual bandit models sequential decision-making problems in which rewards depend on both the chosen action and observed context. In many domains such as medicine, business, and engineering, prior knowledge provides structural information about the reward function that can be exploited to improve optimization efficiency. This paper studies settings where, for each observable context, the conditional mean reward is known to be concave with respect to the action variable. To leverage this structure, we develop a contextual bandit a…
items.why_zh: 把已知的凹性结构注入上下文赌博机，有望在有限试验次数下提升医疗、商业等决策优化的效率。
items.why_en: Injecting known concavity into contextual bandits can improve decision optimization efficiency in domains such as medicine and business under limited trials.

items.title_zh: GLUScope：分析 Transformer 语言模型中 GLU 神经元的工具
items.title_en: GLUScope: A Tool for Analyzing GLU Neurons in Transformer Language Models
items.summary_zh: 研究团队发布开源工具 GLUScope，面向可解释性研究者，用于分析 Transformer 语言模型中的神经元。工具聚焦近年几乎成为标准配置的 GLU 类激活函数（如 SwiGLU）。这类结构带来新挑战：仅理解正激活并不够，因为神经元的 gate 与 in 激活均可正可负，形成四种符号组合（激活象限），需要专门工具加以区分和分析。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2602.23826v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We present **GLUScope**, an open-source resource for analyzing neurons in Transformer-based language models (LMs), intended for interpretability researchers. We focus on the now-standard *GLU-based activation functions* such as SwiGLU, used in virtually all recent open-weights LMs. This introduces a new challenge: understanding positive activations is not enough. Instead, both the *gate* and the *in* activation of a neuron can be positive or negative, leading to four different possible sign combinations (*activation quadrants*) that in…
items.why_zh: GLU 神经元符号组合复杂，专门工具能帮助可解释性研究更准确地定位和分析语言模型内部单元。
items.why_en: GLU neurons have complex sign combinations; dedicated tooling helps interpretability researchers more accurately locate and analyze internal language-model units.

items.title_zh: 用于观看时长分布预测的分层指数-高斯混合模型
items.title_en: Hierarchical Exponential-Gaussian Mixtures for Watch-Time Distribution Prediction
items.summary_zh: 短视频推荐需要准确预测观看时长（WT），但 WT 分布具有近零膨胀、长尾和多峰特征。此前的指数-高斯混合网络（EGMN）建模完整条件分布而非单点估计，并取得领先性能。本文的大规模复现发现 EGMN 易出现方差坍缩、组件冗余和组件不活跃等问题，因此提出分层指数-高斯混合模型（HEGM）以改进预测。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.23356v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Accurate watch-time (WT) prediction is an important requirement for short-video recommendations. Yet WT distributions are near-zero-inflated, long-tailed and multimodal.
